We have not installed mechanical coin counters on this game for two reasons:

1. The bookkeeping program is extremely accurate and includes not only number of coins dropped and dollars earned but also the number of tests and coins in a given period. (See BOOKKEEPING in the DIAGNOSTICS section.)

2. These mechanical coin counters produce an inductive "kick" that w///damage components on the circuit board. Checkerboard video is the most common problem. If this ts, in fact, your problem - take a look at the “NMI not” signal on the master Z80 (pin 17). If a low output is observed, try replacing U114 (74LS08) and/or U119 (74LS157).
